description: Search Mercado Livre, compare prices and technical specs across listings, and build cotações — offline-persisted and agent-native, for procurement automation.

novel_features.name: Aligned spec matrix
novel_features.description: Compare N products side-by-side as a normalized attribute matrix with a price row, so 'which meets 220V and >=700W' is one command instead of six browser tabs.

novel_features.name: Cheapest meeting spec floor
novel_features.description: Find the lowest-priced listing that satisfies attribute floors like voltage and power, evaluated against locally synced spec data.

novel_features.name: Cross-seller price dispersion
novel_features.description: Report min/max/median/stddev of prices across the multiple sellers a single Mercado Livre catalog product aggregates.

novel_features.name: Price drift over time
novel_features.description: Show how a product's price changed across repeated local snapshots, with an optional --since window.

novel_features.name: Cotacao quotation bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble a purchase-request-shaped quotation across chosen products with price, seller, key specs, and captured_at provenance.

novel_features.name: Freshness gate
novel_features.description: List products whose newest price snapshot is older than a threshold, so a cotacao is never built on cold prices.
